Future<void> run(groups, read) async {
 for (final batch in groups) {
  final futures = batch.map(read).toList();
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(futures, eagerError: true);
 }
 for (final batch in groups) {
  final futures = batch.where(valid).map(read).toList();
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await futures.wait;
 }
 for (final batch in groups) {
  final futures = other.map(read).toList();
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait(futures);
 }
}
